messages.english: Keep saved request details with your plan and exports.
messages.translation: Hlayisa vuxokoxoko bya xikombelo lebyi hlayisiweke na pulani ya wena na leswi rhumeriwaka ehandle.
Kambela vuxokoxoko bya xikombelo lebyi hlayisiweke

messages.english: Crop planner → Nursery requirements for saved planned batches
messages.translation: Mupulani wa swibyariwa → Swilaveko swa xirhapa xo kurisa swimilana swa mintlawa leyi kunguhatiweke leyi hlayisiweke

messages.english: Compare a saved batch’s purpose, original entered weight and request dates in nursery, task and report views. Repeated weights describe the whole request and must not be added together. Another site’s records remain held; these details do not confirm current field geometry or an observed harvest.
messages.translation: Pimanisa xikongomelo xa ntlawa lowu hlayisiweke, ntiko wo sungula lowu nghenisiweke na masiku ya xikombelo eka mavonelo ya xirhapa xo kurisa swimilana, mintirho na swiviko. Mintiko leyi phindaphindiweke yi hlamusela xikombelo hinkwaxo naswona a yi fanelanga ku hlanganisiwa swin’we. Tirhekhodo ta sayiti yin’wana ti tshama ti khomiwile; vuxokoxoko lebyi a byi tiyisisi xivumbeko xa nsimu ya sweswi kumbe ntshovelo lowu voniweke.
